cards.example: 明朝初期国力强大，威震四方。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Ming Dynasty was powerful in its early period, commanding awe in all directions.
cards.breakdown: 强：弓（弓）加上小虫（虫），小虫拉开硬弓，力量惊人 · 大：人张开双臂，表示广大有力

cards.example: 明朝疆域广大，而且经济繁荣。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Ming territory was vast, and moreover its economy was prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 而：像下巴上的胡须，表示转折或递进 · 且：像砖头一层层往上叠，表示还有更多

cards.back: to arouse / to stir up / to provoke
cards.example: 明朝末年的苛捐杂税激起了人民的反抗。
cards.exampleTranslation: The harsh taxes in late Ming provoked the people to rebel.
cards.breakdown: 激：水（氵）猛烈冲击（敫），溅起浪花 · 起：自己（己）走起来（走），出发行动

cards.example: 明朝大力发展海外贸易和手工业。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Ming Dynasty vigorously developed overseas trade and handicrafts.
cards.breakdown: 发：头发生长，引申为出发、蓬勃发展 · 展：把衣服（衣）展开铺平，引申为展现和发展

cards.example: 明朝的北京是当时世界上最大的城市之一。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ming Beijing was one of the largest cities in the world at the time.
cards.breakdown: 城：用土（土）筑成的防御墙（成），保护里面的人 · 市：人们聚在一起买卖（巾）东西的地方

cards.example: 明朝修建了许多宏伟的建筑，如故宫。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Ming built many grand buildings, such as the Forbidden City.
cards.breakdown: 建：拿着笔（聿）一步步走出去（廴），建造出来 · 筑：用竹（竹）模具和工具（巩）夯土筑墙

cards.example: 北京城的规划严整有序，气势恢宏。
cards.exampleTranslation: Beijing's urban planning was orderly, well-organized, and imposing.
cards.breakdown: 严：悬崖（厂）上挂着装饰（敢），气氛庄严肃穆 · 整：用棍子（攵）把歪的东西（束）摆正（正），整理整齐

cards.example: 明朝北京的街道宽阔笔直，规划整齐。
cards.exampleTranslation: The streets of Ming Beijing were wide, straight, and well-planned.
cards.breakdown: 街：两个土（圭）夹着行人走的路（行），就是街道 · 道：在路上（辶）用头脑（首）找方向

cards.example: 修建长城是明朝最重要的工程之一。
cards.exampleTranslation: Building the Great Wall was one of the Ming Dynasty's most important projects.
cards.breakdown: 工：像一把尺子，代表工匠和工作 · 程：用禾苗（禾）丈量路程（呈），表示过程和计划

cards.example: 明朝的粮食产量大幅增加。
cards.exampleTranslation: Grain output in the Ming Dynasty increased dramatically.
cards.breakdown: 产：在悬崖（厂）边生产东西，引申为产出 · 量：太阳（日）照着大地（里），丈量多少

cards.example: 多余的农产品被运到城市销售。
cards.exampleTranslation: Surplus agricultural products were transported to cities for sale.
cards.breakdown: 多：两个月亮（夕）叠在一起，表示数量多 · 余：屋子（余）里还剩下的东西，用不完

cards.example: 明朝中后期商业十分繁荣。
cards.exampleTranslation: Commerce was very prosperous in the mid-to-late Ming Dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 商：来来往往讨价还价（商量），做生意的人 · 业：像书架一排排竖立，表示一项事业

cards.example: 明朝商人积累了大量资本，推动了经济发展。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ming merchants accumulated large amounts of capital, driving economic development.
cards.breakdown: 资：用次序（次）管理钱财（贝），就是资金 · 本：树（木）下面加一横，表示树根，引申为根本和本钱

cards.example: 明朝市场上的商品种类繁多。
cards.exampleTranslation: The markets in the Ming Dynasty had numerous varieties of goods.
cards.breakdown: 繁：像枝繁叶茂的大树，丝线（糸）纷纷交织 · 多：两个月亮（夕）叠在一起，非常多

cards.example: 丝绸和瓷器在海外广泛销售。
cards.exampleTranslation: Silk and porcelain were widely sold overseas.
cards.breakdown: 销：用金属（钅）做的东西卖出去（肖），消化库存 · 售：把嘴（口）里的商品卖出去（隹），完成交易

cards.example: 明代青花瓷闻名世界，是中国瓷器的代表。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ming blue-and-white porcelain was world-famous and a symbol of Chinese ceramics.
cards.breakdown: 青：像草木生长的颜色，蓝绿色 · 花：植物（艹）开出的花朵（化）· 瓷：用瓦（瓦）做成的光滑器物（次）

cards.example: 景德镇在明朝成为中国最重要的瓷器中心。
cards.exampleTranslation: Jingdezhen became China's most important porcelain center during the Ming.

cards.back: Suzhou and Hangzhou – two famously prosperous cities
cards.example: 明朝时苏杭是繁华的商业重镇。
cards.exampleTranslation: During the Ming, Suzhou and Hangzhou were prosperous commercial centers.

cards.example: 明朝翻译了许多外国书籍，促进了中外文化交流。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Ming translated many foreign books, promoting cultural exchange between China and abroad.
cards.breakdown: 翻：像鸟翅（羽）扇动，把东西翻转（番）过来 · 译：用语言（讠）把一种话变成（睪）另一种话
